main_text.p: legendum Proverb.6.5.pro נְשִׁבָּא. Forte deductum est à שָׁבָא Capere, quod ponantur laquei ad capien- das aves,vel etiam alia animantia.
סַעְדָן Syr.Flatus,Ventus, בְּסַעְדָן Flatus turbinis, Actor.27.14.
נָשַׁל Hebr. Decutere,dejicere, Ejicere. Hinc Fu- tur.Aphel Chald. וַיַּשֵּׁל יָתָהּ Et ejiciet eam, Deu- ter.24.1. in Jonath.
נשם נִשְׁמְתָא נִשְׁמָא Ch.Anima humana: Halitus an- helitus, Spiritus, respiratio, Hebr. נִשְׁמָה. Plural. נִשְׁמָתָא, נִשְׁמָן Animæ.
נשק Ch. & Syr. Osculatus, deosculatus est. Pahel נְשַׁק Idem.
Syr.Osculum, Osculum sanctum. Plur. Osculæ. Sic Chald. נוּשְׁקְתָא דְסַנְאה Osculæ oforis,Prover.27.6.
נְשִׁיקָה Chald.Deosculatio. Item genus mortis levisi- mæ. Hinc de Mose scribitur, quod mortuus fuerit, עַל נְשִׁיקַת מֵימְרָא דְיְיָ Deuter.34.5. in Jon.
נשר נִשְׁרָא Ch.Aquila. Plur. נִשְׁרִין, Syr. Aquilæ, Lucæ 17.37 Matth.24.28.

נשת נִשְׁתָּוָן Chald.Diploma, Decretum diplomate comprehensum,Epistola,Esræ 4.7.18. Perspicum esse judicatur; quod si ita est,covenit aliquo modo cum נוּשְׁתָּה, Scriptura, Scriptum, Inscriptio, à נוּשְׁתָּא Scri- psit,in lingua Persica.
נתב Ch.Flare, perflare, sufflare. Idem quod שׁ נְשַׁב.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee script rendered approximately; the Hebrew-letter entries are transcribed as best read and may contain errors in vowel points. Catchword absent.
